member.name: T:AspNetCore.Simple.MsTest.Sdk.DynamicRequestLocatorAttribute
member.summary: Attribute that locates use case request JSON files as test data for a given test method.
member.remarks:
This attribute implements the interface for use with parameterized tests. Its purpose is to dynamically locate and supply JSON resources representing use cases based on a specified request folder path and to allow additional parameters to be injected into each test case.
If no request folder is provided in the attribute constructor, the attribute automatically determines the request folder by removing the declaring class's name from its full namespace and appending a ".Requests" suffix.
For example, if a test class is declared in the namespace: Api.User.V1.Create.Status_200_Ok, then by default, the attribute will look for JSON resources in the folder: Api.User.V1.Create.Status_200_Ok.Requests.
The attribute retrieves all the embedded manifest resource names from the test class’s assembly, filters them by a matching folder path and ".json" extension, and then prepares each found resource as a separate test case. Each test case data object consists of the JSON resource identifier as well as any extra parameters provided via the attribute. The method returns a descriptive name that combines the test method's name and the test data details.
The attribute can be applied with or without an explicit request folder and additional parameters.
